comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Cambodia becomes much more interesting once you move beyond Angkor Wat and look at how rapidly the country is changing. 🇰🇭🏙 Phnom Penh, rural villages, tourism, traditional festivals and younger generations all reflect very different sides of modern Cambodian life. The real story is probably less about whether the country is “wild” and more about how tradition and fast economic change are colliding.
